{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Turkey|Turkey]] | [[Cookbook:Rice Recipes|Rice]]

Turkish '''dolma pilav''' also called '''''iç pilav''''' is a spiced [[Cookbook:Pilaf|pilav]]-style [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]] dish that can be used to make stuffed [[Cookbook:Grape leaves|grape leaves]], cabbage rolls, or to stuff vegetables like [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|green peppers]] or [[Cookbook:Zucchini|zucchini]]. It can also be served as a side dish, usually with [[Cookbook:Poultry|poultry]] or [[Cookbook:Lamb|lamb]], or as a main course with [[Cookbook:Liver|liver]]. 

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] basmati [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
*1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*1–2 cups water
*[[Cookbook:Pine Nut|Pine nuts]]
*Dried [[Cookbook:Currant|currants]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
*1–2 tsp dried [[Cookbook:Mint|mint]]
*1–2 tsp white [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*Black [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
*[[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]]

==Procedure==
#Wash the rice until the water runs clear.
#[[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] pine nuts and onions over medium heat in a deep [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] with lid
#Add cinnamon, mint, salt, sugar and black pepper
#Add the rice and stir constantly until the rice turns translucent
#Add water, enough to cover the rice and cook on low heat.
#When the water is absorbed, check the rice. Add more water or spices if needed.
#Quickly add currants; they should soften in the steam but can be soaked in hot water if preferred.
#If needed, use paper towel and a pan with a closed lid to steam the rice until it is finished cooking.

steps.text: Wash the rice until the water runs clear.
Sauté pine nuts and onions over medium heat in a deep skillet with lid
Add cinnamon, mint, salt, sugar and black pepper
Add the rice and stir constantly until the rice turns translucent
Add water, enough to cover the rice and cook on low heat.
When the water is absorbed, check the rice. Add more water or spices if needed.
Quickly add currants; they should soften in the steam but can be soaked in hot water if preferred.
If needed, use paper towel and a pan with a closed lid to steam the rice until it is finished cooking.
